captions.agents_context: Krizaka Agents sits between a ticket and a merged pull request: agents propose, checks refuse, a person decides.
captions.agents_containers: The parts that carry a ticket to a merge; none of them is a model except the sessions themselves.
captions.pr_life: The life of a pull request in twelve steps; at three of them something can refuse it.
captions.alert_life: An alert stays in one table until a person takes it and a proof closes it.

captions.v1_c1: System context (C1): Krizaka Agents sits between the founder, GitHub, model providers, code quality, observability and GPU pods.
captions.v1_c2: Target container view (C2): the core components import only the service ports; VCS, runtime, models, secrets, notifications and storage live in adapters.
captions.v1_tower: Supervision and the tower: scheduled jobs, the watchdog, the operations service and the local cockpit keep every alert and session visible.
captions.v1_events: One event flow in twelve ordered steps: producers emit one structured event shape into one operations sink and export OTel logs.
